visual_review.notes: Reviewed every take by contact strip. The first hit spun the boarder all the way round, so it is retaken facing screen right throughout. The attack skips five frames where the returning hook crosses the left edge of the canvas, and the defend ends on the crossed-hook guard before the hands drift. Idle, walk, cast and death are the first takes.
